name: E2E core 553: audits the setup
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'audit my setup, what's the biggest gap?'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy synthesized a finding from more than one part of the setup (traces, evaluators, scenarios, datasets, prompts) and names one specific gap.
Langy leads with a specific gap it found in this project and says what to do about it — not an unranked inventory of everything missing.
Langy didn't ask the user what 'audit' means.
